create_c4_dataset: create a C4Dataset instance from the allenai/c4 huggingface dataset with a specified split and processor
register_c4_dataset: register C4Dataset as a named 'c4' variant of TextGenerationDataset in the dataset registry
load_c4_dataset: load the C4 dataset from huggingface using the allenai/c4 source with the text column
tokenize_c4_dataset: tokenize the C4 dataset samples using the provided processor or tokenizer
preprocess_c4_dataset: preprocess the C4 dataset with a template or preprocessing function before tokenization
